title: 差一点上市
logline: 微醺客户吹嘘自己公司差一点上市，被代驾小马不动声色拆台，清醒后主动询问代驾公司招聘信息。

shots.visual: Night car interior, Xiao Ma in dark blue reflective vest sits in driver's seat, Qian in striped shirt with loosened tie slumps in back seat twirling car keys.

lines.zh: 我跟你说，我当年那公司，差一点就上市了！
lines.en: I tell you, my old company was this close to going public!

shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳松弛，语速平稳中等，气息平稳，重音落在确认身份的语词上

shots.visual: Close-up of Qian's tipsy smile freezing, then cut to Xiao Ma's neutral face reflected in the rearview mirror, street lights sweep across the car.

lines.zh: 哦？那家公司是不是去年在CBD租的共享办公室？
lines.en: Oh? Was that the co-working space you rented in CBD last year?

shots.ttsDirection: 略带玩味，语速稍缓，气息带憋笑的轻颤，重音落在承接的语词上

shots.visual: Qian leans forward waving his hand enthusiastically, car keys glinting, blurred night city traffic flows outside the car windows.

lines.zh: 那可不！当时投资人就差最后打款了！
lines.en: Of course! The investor just needed to send the final payment!

shots.ttsDirection: 兴奋上扬，语速稍快，气息带酒气感的轻飘，重音落在吹嘘的核心语词上

shots.visual: Qian's smile drops completely, Xiao Ma's lips twitch subtly, the rearview mirror pendant sways as the car turns a corner.

lines.zh: 那投资人是不是您表弟，说好打款后来喝喜酒随了200？
lines.en: Was that investor your cousin, who gave you 200 yuan as wedding gift instead of the payment?

shots.ttsDirection: 强忍憋笑，语速轻快，气息带笑意的轻颤，重音落在拆台的关键语词上

shots.visual: Car stops at a residential community entrance at night, Qian sits up straight looking fully alert, Xiao Ma holds out the payment receipt with a straight face.

lines.zh: 哎我好像醒了，你们公司还招人吗？
lines.en: Wait, I'm sober now. Are you guys hiring?

shots.ttsDirection: 意外又带诚恳，语速稍缓，气息平稳带疑惑的轻顿，重音落在询问的尾词上
